Morning skincare routine that actually works — and yes, order matters more than you think. Here's the correct sequence to follow every single morning: ✔ Cleanser — skip it if your skin is very dry (over-cleansing is a real thing) ✔ Toner — preps and balances your skin ✔ Vitamin C serum — always apply this one first ✔ Hyaluronic acid serum — lock in that hydration on top ✔ Moisturizer — seal everything in ✔ Sunscreen — non-negotiable, every single day The reason Vitamin C goes before Hyaluronic acid? Vitamin C works best on clean, dry skin at a lower pH — applying it first means better absorption.  Hyaluronic acid then pulls moisture into the skin and keeps it there. Layering them in the right order = you actually get the benefits you're paying for. Most people either skip steps, use the wrong order, or pile everything on at once and wonder why their skin isn't improving. finally did a skincare routine 🦦💗 this is just what i use and it might not work for everyone! i found the best way to treat my acne and other skin issues was learning more about my skin (my skin type, what kind of acne with my dermatologist) and my biggest piece of advice for anyone who is dealing with skin issues: it’s not permanent and things take time! a pimple can take 1-2 weeks to form and a few more to go away and a lot of products take just as long to show results. i learned to normalize acne/skin issues because everyone goes through them and that’s helped my anxiety/stress when it comes to how my skin looks so much. i’ll probably make another video about how i desensitized myself to my skin issues and how important that is 🤍 i just started up tretinoin a month ago at 0.025% twice a week and my skin has been incredibly dry but i think i’ve finished most of the purging 🙂 excited to see more results from it! products 🪽: @mixsoon_official bean cleansing oil + centella cleansing foam @anua.skincare_us toner pads @mediheal_official tea tree toner pads @Pyunkang Yul (편강율) essence toner @imfrom_global mugwort essence @apieu.official madecassoside cream 2x tretinoin 0.025% (prescription) @Kiehl’s Since 1851 avocado eye cream @Laniege_us lip sleeping mask #skincare #skincareroutine #skincareproducts #koreanskincare #asianskincare #koreanskincareroutine #koreanskin #glassskin #acnetreatment
